name: mirage
text: You're right, I was wrong about the wallet. It shows $50.60 cash and $118 equity now; I had read an old digest. The engine is live and looking; its last pass ordered nothing because every bet it saw was more than 48 hours out. Building the hand block now. It refuses a by-hand bet on any type proven to lose (300 or more settled bets, clearly negative), and those bets no longer appear in the Feed or the CNO list. Today that is player prop overs (-15% over 527 bets) and NFL player props (-10% over 474). NCAAB and game totals aren't in the profile's proven list yet, so they are not blocked; the engine already skips them. Running the full tests now; I'll send the release link here when it's out.
